devdoc.author: HessianX
devdoc.details: ERC-4626 compliantDoes not support rebasing or transfer fee tokens.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by a call to {approve}. `value` is the new allowance.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to another (`to`). Note that `value` may be zero.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `amount` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

decimals().details: Decimals are computed by adding the decimal offset on top of the underlying asset's decimals. This "original" value is cached during construction of the vault contract. If this read operation fails (e.g., the asset has not been created yet), a default of 18 is used to represent the underlying asset's decimals. See {IERC20Metadata-decimals}.

decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically decreases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address. - `spender` must have allowance for the caller of at least `subtractedValue`.

increaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically increases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

notCustodiedAndDuringFunding().details: Only to be used with previewDeposit and previewMint

notCustodiedAndNotDuringEpoch().details: Only to be used with previewRedeem and previewWithdraw

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

returnFunds(uint256).details: The trader is responsible for returning the whole sum taken into custody.          Losses may be sustained during the trading, in which case the investors will suffer a loss.          Returning the funds ends the epoch.

params._status: True for whitelisted, false for blacklisted

params._statuses: True for whitelisted, false for blacklisted

params._epochEnd: End timestamp of the epoch in unix epoch seconds
params._epochStart: Start timestamp of the epoch in unix epoch seconds
params._fundingStart: Start timestamp of the funding phase in unix epoch seconds

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `amount`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `amount`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `amount`.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

sourceSemantics.underlying: Constructor immutable asset native Arbitrum USDC0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831,6decimals. ERC4626 offset0 yields6decimal shares. Current registry branding Alpha Strategies/HYPE++ does not imply separate protocol or target.
sourceSemantics.whitelist: Every deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem onlyWhitelisted gates msg.sender: explicit whitelisted flag OR balanceOf(whitelistAsset)>whitelistBalance (strict>). Owner may mutate all three. Owner/receiver need not be caller but standard share allowance authorizes delegated exit. No catalog whitelist bypass.
sourceSemantics.entry: Deposit/mint require notCustodied,duringFunding and caps; raw caller USDC allowance to vault required. No caller-set slippage/deadline.
sourceSemantics.exit: Immediate ERC4626 withdraw/redeem only outside epoch and not custodied. No queued request/claim methods. Trader return can end epoch early; ending timestamp alone cannot override custody. Whitelist remains required to exit.
sourceSemantics.custodyAndNAV: Immutable trader takes entire vault balance during epoch. totalAssets while custodied is recorded custodiedAmount, not current strategy mark. Return positive amount can realize loss, clears custody and updates totalDeposits. No user guarantee of cash/date/profit.
sourceSemantics.feesRounding: Vault has no fee deduction itself. Source dependency virtual+1 arithmetic; deposit/redeem down,mint/withdraw up. External strategy fee/PnL effects remain.
sourceSemantics.administration: Owner schedules funding/epoch through max3650days and changes capacity/whitelist. No separate pause variable, UUPS/proxy upgrade entry, generic executor or user queue. Administration,trader custody,share transfers/approvals excluded.
sourceSemantics.terms: Official current terms require legal eligibility/sophistication and exclude numerous territories including US/UK; contract whitelist is not legal approval. V0 trading dependency can rely on Porto policy engine per current disclosure, not a closed user-executor grant.
